named_question: Can the recovered SName-specific ASCII uppercase conversion be offered explicitly without silently approximating transliteration or punctuation normalization?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Actual display-name normalizer performs representation conversion, case conversion and punctuation/degree replacement; the admitted ASCII subset avoids all but case conversion.
ASCII a..z maps exactly to A..Z; admitted uppercase letters, digits and ordinary spaces remain unchanged.

reused_contract.fact: Reuse exact direct selected SName setter, common ASCII-normalization no-change subset and preservation/clear boundary. The original default uppercase-only path remains unchanged.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-display-name FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME --name NAME --normalize-ascii
CLI_policy.opt_in: Default remains strict uppercase ASCII letters/digits/internal spaces with alphanumeric edges. Explicit --normalize-ascii permits lowercase ASCII only by applying the recovered uppercase conversion before the same strict validation.
CLI_policy.unsupported: No trimming, punctuation replacement, transliteration, arbitrary Unicode conversion or control-character sanitation. Unsupported input fails before mutation. The flag requires nonempty --name and conflicts with --clear.
CLI_policy.report: after is actual uppercase storage; normalized_from records the original supplied text when conversion occurred, including a storage no-op. Existing CSV column order stays unchanged; AFTER displays actual value.
CLI_policy.preservation: Only selected SName changes. Raw Name, IDs, flags, Qn, counts/order/width, LSConfig, HCL, capabilities, sequences and unknown storage remain. Equivalent normalized no-op preserves all in-place bytes.
